test1_init.description: Initialize listing — creates authority row + operation record

test2_idempotent.description: Idempotent replay — same operation_id + same request_hash returns identical result

test3_conflict.description: Conflict rejection — same operation_id + different request_hash raises OPERATION_ID_CONFLICT

test4_stale.description: Stale version rejection — expected_version=5 on version=0 listing returns CONFLICT

test5_rollback.description: Rollback — injected post-update failure (INJECTED_FAILURE) rolls back all database changes

test6_concurrent.description: 100 concurrent distinct reservation attempts against one version → exactly 1 winner, 99 CONFLICT

test7_release.description: Release — CAS release by winning buyer, version increments, state returns to available

test8_recovery.description: Unknown response recovery — query by operation_id returns committed status + stored result_json

test9_incident.description: 100 concurrent incident writes with same incident_key → exactly 1 row (UNIQUE constraint)

test10_privileges.description: Executor privilege denial — INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, ALTER all denied

test11_latency.description: Connection and operation latency (20 samples of get_state via Neon HTTP driver)

cleanup.description: All synthetic rows deleted — zero remaining in all probe tables
